description: Toets- en veiligheidsoordelen primaire waterkeringen (WBI) is a dataset listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by PDOK. This dataset contains a national picture of the safety assessment for the primary flood defences. The dates were created in the context of the fourth assessment round and from the Legal Assessment Toolbox (WBI). Coverage: NL. The portal shows the English title as "Assessment and safety assessments of primary flood defences (WBI)" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
